page.overview:
Who is Abrish?

Abrish was a Muun male who worked for a small enslavement empire on the planet of Oon during the Age of the Empire.

Abrish worked for MaDall's small enslavement operation on Oon, managing the acquisition of new slaves. At least once in 4 BBY, Abrish oversaw a new shipment of slaves collected from all across the Lothal sector, informing the empire's leader, MaDall, of her newest acquisitions to arrive from aboard an Aurore-class freighter, which included a Mandalorian called Sabine Wren.

A male Muun, Abrish had green skin and gold eyes. He was aloof to slavery and sought to please his master, MaDall, with those slaves he acquired.

Abrish first appeared, albeit unnamed, in "Return of the Slavers," a comic strip found in the fifth issue of the Star Wars Rebels Magazine. Abrish later received a name in a Twitter post by Martin Fisher, who showed a part of the script of "Return of the Slavers" to confirm Abrish's name and that they are a Muun.
